definition: to stop the flow of something at its source
description: A small kitchen with orange tiles and wooden cupboards. A burst pipe shoots a jet of water up to the ceiling. A young woman in a wet blue T-shirt lies on the wet floor and reaches deep into the open cupboard under the sink to turn the water valve, her face tense. The jet stops, a plastic bowl falls to the floor, and she sits up laughing. A young man in a white T-shirt stands over her laughing, holding a saucepan of water. Dishes sit in a rack by the window.

taps.phrase: to catch water in a saucepan
